description: This source file defines the `Allergen` class, an embeddable Java entity used within a healthcare application (OpenMRS) to represent allergen information associated with patients. It includes properties for allergen type, references to concepts, and related methods for managing allergen data.

classes.name: Allergen
classes.description: Embeddable class representing an allergen, with properties for allergen type, coded allergen concept, and non-coded allergen description, including utility methods for comparison and string representation.

methods.name: Allergen
methods.description: Default no-argument constructor for initializing an empty Allergen instance.

methods.name: Allergen
methods.description: Constructor for creating an Allergen with specified type, coded concept, and non-coded description.

methods.name: getCodedAllergen
methods.description: Returns the linked Concept representing a coded allergen.

methods.name: setCodedAllergen
methods.description: Sets the concept for a coded allergen and potentially clears the non-coded allergen if the concept isn't the 'other' uuid.

methods.name: setOtherNonCodedConceptUuid
methods.description: Static method to set the UUID used to identify 'Other' non-coded concepts.

methods.name: getOtherNonCodedConceptUuid
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the UUID used to identify 'Other' non-coded concepts.

methods.name: getNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Returns the non-coded allergen string description.

methods.name: setNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Sets the non-coded allergen string and clears the coded concept if necessary.

methods.name: isCoded
methods.description: Returns true if there is a coded allergen concept that is not the 'Other' uuid.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the non-coded allergen string if present, otherwise the name of the coded concept.

methods.name: isSameAllergen
methods.description: Determines if this allergen is equivalent to another allergen, considering both coded and non-coded matching criteria.
